Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Sandeep Tiwari, learned Counsel for the 
petitioners.
2. Mr. N.S. Pundir, learned Dy.A.G. for the State.
3. This Court, vide order dated 07.07.2026, had 
made a specific query from the State Counsel 
regarding the averments made in paragraph nos.5,6 
and 7 of the said order, and instructions were sought. 
4. Today, the instructions are shown to this Court 
by learned State Counsel and except replying the 
query raised by this Court, many things have been 
stated. Attention of the Court was also drawn to the 
Government Order dated 01.06.2026, wherein, in 
exercise of powers under Section 27 of the Uttarakhand Annual Transfer for Public Servants Act, 
2017 (hereinafter to be referred to as “the Act”), certain 
provisions have been incorporated in the government 
order. It is contended by learned Dy.A.G. appearing 
for the State that in view of aforesaid government 
order, transfers have been effected. 
5. This Court is of the view that the Committee 
contemplated under the provisions of the Act, is 
required to submit its recommendation for the 
approval of Chief Minister regarding the difficulties 
arising in application of this Act, and thereafter, the 
State Government may make rules, as required. The 
said provision has been made under Section 27(2) of 
the Act. 
6. Issuance of a government order, in gross 
violation of provision of Section 27, along with 
aforesaid explanation put forth by learned State 
Counsel, cannot save the State Government to pass
the impugned transfer orders which are in teeth of 
provisions of Transfer Act, 2017, particularly, Section 
6 of the Act. 
7. On the request made by learned State Counsel, 
post these matters on 15.07.2026 as fresh. 
8. Interim orders, granted earlier, shall continue to 
operate till then.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 13.07.2026 R.Dang

Ajay Singh Rawat ………Petitioner

State of Uttarakhand and others ………Respondents
With
WPSS Nos.1705, 1706, 1709, 1710, 1720, 1721, 1722, 1723, 
1724, 1725, 1726, 1727, 1728, 1729, 1730, 1731, 1732, 1733 
and 1734 all of the year 2026
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Sandeep Tiwari, learned counsel for the petitioners.
2. Mr. N.S. Pundir, learned D.A.G. for the State.
3. This Court has made a specific query from the State in 
its order dated 07.07.2026 in para nos.6 and 7 which is quote 
hereunder:-
“6. Prima-facie, this Court finds substance in the 
contention raised by learned counsel for petitioners. 
Section 6 of the Transfer Act contemplates the following 
transfers:-
(a) Compulsory transfer from accessible area to remote 
area; 
(b) Compulsory transfer from remote area to accessible 
area; and 
(c) Transfer on the basis of request. 
7. The transfer order impugned does not fall in any of 
the above category. If it is a transfer under category (a) 
and (b) as stated above, it is not clear as to whether 
respondents have prepared any eligibility list for effecting 
the transfer under category (a) and (b).”
4. Learned counsel for the State was directed to get 
instructions in the matter as to under which category the 
transfers effected by the respondent fall.
5. Despite opportunity, twice, query made by this Court has 
not been answered by the State Counsel. Unnecessary reliance 
is being placed upon a government order which according to 
the petitioner was issued on 01.06.2026 under Section 27 of  2
the Rules and Section 13 of the Uttarakhand Annual Transfer 
for Public Servants Act, 2017 which has nothing to do with the 
query made by this Court.
6. Learned counsel for the State is directed to file counter 
affidavit within six weeks.
7. List this case on 01.09.2026.
8. In the meantime, interim order dated 07.07.2026 is 
extended qua the petitioners. 
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 15.07.2026
SK
